title: Add Locale('he') RTL variant to tutor_pin_reset_screen_l1_test.dart and tutor_pin_setup_screen_l1_test.dart
why: Neither file contains a single Locale('he') pump, so RTL/overflow regressions in the PIN-reset and PIN-setup screens (part of the same security-sensitive tutor-PIN flow) are invisible to this suite. The sibling test in the same directory, tutor_pin_entry_gate_l1_test.dart, DOES carry a Hebrew group ('he locale: renders PIN entry screen without overflow or crash') proving the flow is expected to be RTL-tested — these two screens are the odd ones out. coding-standards.md's own TQ-3 rationale states this app ships RTL/overflow fixes 'every audit wave', so an LTR-only gap here is a live, stated-cost risk, not a hypothetical one.
recommendation: Add a `he` locale smoke test to each file mirroring tutor_pin_entry_gate_l1_test.dart's Hebrew group (pump with Locale('he'), assert no exception and the Scaffold/key text renders).
acceptance_criteria: tutor_pin_reset_screen_l1_test.dart and tutor_pin_setup_screen_l1_test.dart each gain a testWidgets case pumping Locale('he') that asserts the screen renders without throwing.
